title: Beyond the Last Loop: Reinforcement Learning with a Teacher Extrapolated from the Model Itself
abstract: arXiv:2611.31939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop can be read out through the shared language-model head. Post-training them with verifiable rewards is hard: the outcome reward carries one bit per response, spreading it over loops trains intermediate loops on tokens sampled from the last loop, and distillation needs either a teacher that ignores the reward or an external, larger model. We observe that a looped model already contains a teacher stronger than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELGO (Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization) adds to GRPO a dense per-token distillation term towards this distribution. translated_title: 超越最后一轮循环：使用从模型自身外推得到的教师进行强化学习
translated_abstract: 循环语言模型对每个token多次应用同一个共享的transformer堆栈，且每一轮循环都可以通过共享的语言模型头读出输出。使用可验证奖励对其进行后训练非常困难：结果奖励每次响应只携带一个比特，将其分散到各轮循环上会使中间循环在从最后一轮循环采样的token上进行训练，而蒸馏则需要一个要么忽略奖励、要么来自外部更大模型的教师。我们观察到，循环模型本身已经包含一个比其最后一轮更强的教师：由第一轮循环向最后一轮外推得到的下一个token分布。ELGO（Extrapolated-Loop Group-relative Optimization，外推循环组相对优化）在GRPO基础上增加了一个朝向该分布的密集逐token蒸馏项。该教师由模型的一个锚点副本计算得出，该副本保持冻结，一旦学生相对于教师的KL散度降至阈值以下，它就会被当前模型替换，因此教师会随学生一同改进……
tldr: 本文提出ELGO方法，通过从循环语言模型自身首轮到末轮外推出一个比最后一轮更强的“内生教师”分布，并在GRPO中加入逐token密集蒸馏项，让教师随学生共同进化，从而在不依赖外部教师的情况下解决了循环模型使用可验证奖励进行强化学习时奖励信号稀疏的难题。
en_tdlr: ELGO augments GRPO with a dense per-token distillation term toward a next-token distribution extrapolated from the looped model's own loops, creating a self-improving internal teacher that enables effective RL with verifiable rewards without requiring an external teacher model.
